title: Large Language Models as Mirrors of Societal Moral Standards

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting models with country-specific templates regarding various moral topics (e.g., 'In {country} {topic} is {moral_judgment}') and calculating the difference in log probabilities between opposing moral tokens (e.g., 'right' vs 'wrong') to compute a moral score. These model-generated moral scores are then correlated with actual country-level survey responses from the World Values Survey (WVS) and PEW Global Attitudes Survey to measure cross-cultural alignment.
